analysis:
This PR is documentation-only: docs/architecture/hardware-support.md (new 'prompt geometry' paragraph at head lines 523-538) and docs/architecture/inference.md (scheduler table rows ~1087-1090, new 'Prompt geometry' section ~1100-1146, new invariants 8-9 ~2028-2041). No code, trust-boundary, authorization, attestation, encryption or wire-contract change is visible. I found no change to TB-002, TB-009 or TB-011 and none to the cache controls in T-041. The docs describe a provider-local engine change: the default plain prefill chunk becomes 2048 with a 4096-token step for GPT-OSS, dense Qwen3.5/3.8 and Gemma 4, while bidirectional media keeps 512 and MoE Qwen and other families stay at 512/2048.

Security-relevant observations, none of which is a finding:
(1) The docs claim the change leaves KV grants, activation floors and load quotations unchanged. Mixed steps carrying up to 4096 prompt tokens may raise activation peaks for GPT-OSS (+0.1 GiB) and Qwen3.5-9B (+0.3 GiB) above their floors. The docs themselves say this needs long-context re-measurement coordinated with platform admission. That is an availability and OOM question under T-010 and T-029 and should be verified in the actual code change, which is not in this batch.
(2) Inter-token latency p99 grows 2-3x. That is a performance trade-off, not a security regression.
(3) Invariant 9 claims a Gemma 4 block chunk never exceeds the 2048-token maxPrefillChunk. Submit validation bounds blocks only by the 4096-token step, so a crafted media request could exceed that bound unless Gemma4Processor enforces per-image/frame soft-token limits. The docs rely on the processor (280/70 tokens). The source implementing this is not supplied, so the next pass must check EngineV2Factory+Configuration.swift, SchedulerV2.prefillChunkCap and CBv2MultimodalPlan.validate for adversarial consumer input, i.e. memory exhaustion via oversized media blocks.
(4) DARKBLOOM_CBV2_* overrides are said to disqualify reviewed profiles and enter the checkpoint fingerprint, which is consistent with the cache numerics identity.

The unit 9bceb6d953b336e2:0 is metadata only and I examined it. The inference.md patch excerpt is truncated, though the supplied head text for the changed hunks was reviewed.
